title: Tool library
summary: Borrow tools from a shared community library.
whyTempting: Most tools are used minutes per year.
whyItFails: Volunteer reliance. Libraries depend on volunteers. Maintenance. Tools break and go missing. Low revenue. Members pay little.

attempts.notes: Public tool lending since 1979; tool libraries typically rely on volunteers and community grants.
